appearance_facts.fact: Subtitle: 'Reported window shown in the dashboard summary'.
A single teal line with circular data points connects the years 2017 to 2020.
The data point for 2017 is at 260 enrolled patients.

public_definitions: Review the telehealth follow-up enrollment dashboard and select the operational route that best reflects the enrollment pattern across the 2013-2020 review window.

Use the displayed enrollment trajectory for the full review window to determine whether this record should be routed for sustained growth planning, ongoing monitoring of a more recent upswing, or decline-response assessment.
